questions.question: The word "abundant" means
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities, i.e. plentiful.

questions.question: The word "brief" means
questions.explanation: Brief means lasting a short time or using few words.

questions.question: The word "rapid" means
questions.explanation: Rapid means happening at great speed.

questions.question: The word "ancient" means
questions.explanation: Ancient means belonging to a very distant past.

questions.question: The word "reluctant" means
questions.explanation: Reluctant means not willing to do something.

questions.question: The word "delicious" means
questions.explanation: Delicious describes food that tastes very good.

questions.question: Which prefix gives the opposite of "responsible"?
questions.explanation: Before the letter r the negative prefix is ir-, giving irresponsible.

questions.question: Which prefix gives the opposite of "possible"?
questions.explanation: Before the letter p the negative prefix is im-, giving impossible.

questions.question: The noun form of the verb "decide" is
questions.explanation: Decide → decision (noun). Decisive is an adjective.

questions.question: The adjective form of the noun "danger" is
questions.explanation: The suffix -ous forms the adjective: dangerous.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "He gave me good ___ on how to prepare for the interview."
questions.explanation: Advice is the noun; advise is the verb. The adjective "good" needs a noun.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "Heavy rain can ___ the harvest."
questions.explanation: Affect is a verb meaning to influence; effect is usually a noun.

questions.question: One word for "a person who writes books" is
questions.explanation: An author writes books.

questions.question: The word "frugal" means
questions.explanation: A frugal person spends money carefully and avoids waste.

questions.question: One word for "a person who loves mankind and gives help to others" is
questions.explanation: A philanthropist works to improve the lives of others, often by giving money or time.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The word has a double c and a double m.

questions.question: The word "benevolent" means
questions.explanation: The root bene means good, so benevolent means well-meaning and kind.

questions.question: The idiom "a piece of cake" means
questions.explanation: The phrase is used for a task that is very easy to do.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "The school ___ announced the results."
questions.explanation: Principal means the head of a school; principle means a rule. Here the head announces the results.

questions.question: The word "meticulous" means
questions.explanation: A meticulous person pays close attention to every detail.
